description: Count how often each word appears in a block of text, sorted from most to least frequent. Returns the total word count, the number of unique words, and the top 20 words with their counts and percentages. Common stop words (the, and, of, ...) can optionally be ignored. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/word-frequency-counter/

ignoreStopwords.description: Ignore common words such as the, and, of, to (default false)
